item.title: Practical Magic 2 Is a Gamble on the Power of Cult Movies
item.description: To kick off the fall box office swing, Practical Magic 2 summoned $30 million domestically over its opening weekend. It’s a solid if unspectacular start for a film with a $75 million production budget, but what’s most surprising is that the sequel was greenlit to begin with. The original Practical Magic, released in 1998, didn’t have the commercial performance (or positive critical sentiment) that would typically warrant a follow-up. item.title: AI’s Threats Demand a Better Movie Analogy Than The Terminator
item.description: As fear of what unfettered AI could mean for humanity has exploded into the public consciousness, media commentators have been grasping for ways to help understand what that really means. Not surprisingly, many found points of reference in movies, with The Terminator’s Skynet becoming “self-aware” as shorthand for conceptualizing how “tech run amok” could trigger our demise.
item.dc:creator: Brian Lowry

item.title: Hyrox Incident Shows Dangers of Letting Ambition Outrun Growth
item.description: The organizers of the high-endurance fitness race have discovered how painful it can be when you forget who your audience is.
